title: Resuscitate

inlines.v: RESUS'CITATE, verb transitive [Latin resuscito; re and suscito, to raise.] 1. To revivify; to revive; particularly, to recover from apparent death; as, to resuscitate a drowned person; to resuscitate withered plants. 2. To reproduce, as a mixed body from its ashes.
